name: flowlog_benchmark
description:
FlowLog Benchmark
	

Benchmark datasets and programs for FlowLog, an efficient, extensible, and scalable Datalog engine for incremental computation.

	
		
		Repository Structure
	


dataset/csv/ — Benchmark datasets (zipped CSV files)
program/flowlog_interpreter/ — Datalog program files for the FlowLog interpreter


	
		
		Usage
	

Download a dataset:
wget https://huggingface.co/datasets/NemoYuu/flowlog_benchmark/resolve/main/dataset/csv/<name>.zip

Download an interpreter program:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NemoYuu/flowlog_benchmark.
reputation: Niche dataset tied to the FlowLog Datalog engine; primarily used by the FlowLog/system research community with limited broader adoption.
